about: Reference looks of classic drinks (expert estimates) used to calibrate web/lib/optics.js; hexes are top, middle, bottom.

calibrationMeanDelta.unit: luma-weighted RGB distance to reference body color (0-255 scale), 50 drinks

references.look: Hazy amber-gold over crushed ice: aged Jamaican rum supplies the amber, orgeat and lime the milky haze. Spent lime shell and a big mint bouquet on top; no float in Vic's spec. Modern bar versions add a dark-rum float, which puts a mahogany band (#5c2a12) on the ice cap.
Deep reddish amber-copper in a tall chimney glass of crushed ice: three rums incl. 1 oz Demerara 151, a teaspoon of grenadine and pink Don's Mix push it ruddy. Mint sprig; not orange, not red.
Opaque tan / pale apricot-beige: Pusser's mahogany rum browns the white coconut and yellow pineapple, orange juice warms it. Heavy dusting of brown nutmeg on a pale froth.
Opaque, pale creamy yellow, frothy and frozen; white rum adds no color. Pineapple wedge and cherry.

Cloudy sea-green turquoise, not sky blue: 1/2 oz blue curacao against 3 oz yellow pineapple mixes subtractively to green-teal, with a paler pineapple froth on top. Vivid aqua only when the curacao is 1 oz or more or the pineapple is cut (the resort Blue Hawaii that most photos show).
Opaque pastel aqua: the coconut cream turns the turquoise of a Blue Hawaii into a milky sky-teal.

references.drink: Hurricane (Smuggler's Cove, black rum + passion fruit)
references.look: Russet / burnt orange-brown: 4 oz black rum darkens golden passion fruit syrup. A Hurricane with gold rum and passion syrup is golden-orange (#e79a3c).
Coral red-orange in the hurricane glass: the red is grenadine/Fassionola-style mix, not passion fruit itself. Orange wheel and cherry flag.

Opaque brick-coral to rust: Campari red + pineapple yellow = coral, darkened by black/dark Jamaican rum; a pinkish pineapple foam head. Revival spec (1.5 oz pineapple) is darker, rust-brown (#a4442a).
Hazy honey-amber around a frozen ice cone (white, tinted where the drink wets it) with the straw through it.
Copper-amber over crushed ice with a rust-red crown of Angostura dashed on top that bleeds down in streaks.
Opaque coral-pink with a frothy pale-pink pineapple head; Cherry Heering and grenadine give the red, pineapple the opacity.
Frothy, opaque pale celadon-green: blended fresh mint tints a pineapple-honey frappe. Mint sprig.
Cloudy pale golden-yellow (passion fruit + orgeat haze on clear gin); citrus peel "rings of Saturn" garnish.
Cloudy orange-amber; three cherries and a pineapple stick (Morse code V).
Cloudy pale orange-gold (orange, lemon, orgeat on white rum and brandy) under a thin topaz float of sherry.
Cloudy pale orange-yellow; served communal with a flaming float and gardenias.
Cloudy pink-orange from grenadine in the orange-pineapple base; often a flaming 151 well in the center.
Reddish amber, faintly opalescent from pastis, lightened by soda. With Vic's Tahitian (light) rum it is pale rosy (#e7ad94).
The canonical three-layer swizzle: green mint leaves packed in the bottom third, amber-mahogany rum in the middle, a rust-red Angostura crown on top bleeding downward.
references.spec: explicit: 2 oz rum-demerara, 0.75 oz lime, 0.5 oz demerara-syrup, 0 oz mint, 0.12 oz angostura (crown)

references.look: Cloudy pale chartreuse yellow-green (green Chartreuse into yellow pineapple), crushed ice, grated nutmeg and mint.
Frozen raspberry-magenta slush: blackberry liqueur purple + grenadine red + banana amber. Uncertain; versions with orange/pineapple are red-orange.
Cloudy golden-tan: pineapple-heavy, browned slightly by coffee liqueur and dark rum. Resort versions with grenadine are orange-red.
The canonical sunrise gradient: orange juice on top, grenadine poured last sinks to a deep red band at the bottom, blushing orange-red where they meet.
references.spec: explicit: 1.5 oz tequila-blanco, 4 oz orange, 0.5 oz grenadine (sink)

references.look: Near-clear sparkling body with a pale lime haze; muddled mint and lime pieces green the bottom.
Pale, faintly green-white translucent haze in a coupe; fine ice shards on the surface.
Black-brown Goslings floated on pale hazy ginger beer: a dark cap fading through a murky storm-cloud band to pale gold.
Opaque creamy golden-yellow (butter-honey Gardenia Mix emulsified by flash blending) in the ridged Pearl Diver glass.
Cloudy red-orange: bourbon amber + golden passion fruit + grenadine.
Translucent-hazy amber-copper over crushed ice.
Hazy copper-amber, darker than the Test Pilot (Demerara 151, cinnamon syrup).
Cloudy orange-amber; Demerara 151 browns golden passion fruit and orange. Lime-wheel-and-mint "fang" garnish.
Pale amber-straw long drink, hazy from ginger beer, mint and orange garnish.
Cloudy golden amber-orange, spiced.
Cloudy golden-apricot with a fine pineapple froth in a coupe.
Strawberry puree poured first, colada blended on top: red lava streaks up the glass walls through an opaque cream-white body.
Pale straw, softly hazy (pineapple gum) with a pineapple chunk.
Pale hazy lime-white with muddled lime wedges and undissolved sugar at the bottom.
Water-clear to faint straw, neat or one cube, with a coin of lime peel.
Amber over crushed ice, Angostura deepening it red-brown. With blackstrap rum (common modern spec) it is near-black (#3a1a0e).
Cloudy toffee-brown in a mug, a golden butter slick and cinnamon dust on the surface.
Cloudy coral-amber: bourbon, orange, pineapple, a blush of grenadine.
Cloudy orange-amber; Goslings browns the pineapple-orange.
Translucent dark amber-copper (Demerara + dark Jamaican, allspice dram).
Cloudy golden-orange long drink (passion fruit, orange, soda) browned by black rum; orange-peel snake garnish.
Translucent neon lime-green.
references.spec: explicit: 1 oz melon-liqueur, 1 oz vodka, 0.5 oz lemon, 0.5 oz lime, 2 oz soda-water

references.look: Translucent vivid sky-blue (blue curacao in a clear base): what blue curacao does when nothing yellow is present.
references.spec: explicit: 1.5 oz vodka, 1 oz blue-curacao, 0.5 oz lemon, 4 oz lemon-lime-soda

references.look: Opaque pale banana-cream frappe.
references.spec: explicit: 2 oz rum-white-column, 3.5 oz banana, 1 oz lime, 0.5 oz simple-syrup

references.look: Opaque pink-red frozen slush with seeds.
references.spec: explicit: 2 oz rum-white-column, 2.5 oz strawberry, 1 oz lime, 0.75 oz simple-syrup

references.look: Dark garnet-brown, translucent at the edges, lime wedge.
references.spec: explicit: 2 oz rum-white-column, 0.5 oz lime, 4 oz cola
